periods.time: The morning after Bell's Lv.2 celebration
periods.label: Welf meets Bell and proposes a direct smith contract

status.goal: be Bell's personal smith and party member

appearance.overview: Red-haired young smith in black kimono-like work clothes; older and taller than Bell.

attire.combat: same black work clothes with a large sword

personality.summary: Direct, proud, frustrated by poor sales, and deeply moved that Bell genuinely values his work.
fears: losing Bell as his first real customer to other smiths
personality.inner_conflict: He wants recognition for his own craft while being burdened by the inherited Crozzo name.

decision_pattern.business: Moves fast to secure a fair contract before competitors can approach Bell.

quote_samples: 要不要直接跟我订契约啊，贝尔·克朗尼？

mannerisms: laughs loudly when Bell asks for his work
puts an arm around Bell's shoulders
uses a handshake to seal agreement
habits.daily_routine: Works in Hephaestus Familia's shop and personal workshop.
quirks: does not like being called by his surname

background.upbringing: Raised in a smithing family whose elders wanted him to restore Crozzo glory through magic swords.
formative_events: Bell bought and returned to buy his armor, becoming his first true fan/customer
background.pre_story: His works were shoved into corners, returned by buyers, or ignored despite their quality.

relationships.bell-cranel: First genuine customer; Welf asks for a direct contract and then party membership.
relationships.liliruca-arde: Bell's supporter who distrusts him at first and calls him Crozzo to needle him.

knowledge: Knows Bell is the record-breaking Little Rookie
Knows other smiths want Bell as a customer
secrets: Can forge true Crozzo magic swords but refuses to do so.
periods.summary: Welf reveals himself as the maker of Bell's earlier armor, secures a personal smith contract, offers equipment, and asks to join Bell's party.

key_events.summary: Welf and Bell agree to a direct smith-adventurer contract, after which Welf asks to join Bell's party.

periods.time: First party run with Bell and Lili on the 11th floor
periods.label: Welf joins Bell to gain Forge and proves his combat value

appearance.overview: Wears black work clothes even in the dungeon and fights with a large sword carried over the shoulder.

personality.summary: Bold in battle, grateful to Bell, teasing toward Lili, and proud enough to fight for his own growth despite familia ostracism.
fears: being isolated like in earlier solo attempts
being reduced to Crozzo bloodline value
desires: make weapons that do not betray their users
strengths: party-awareness after fighting with Bell and Lili
flaws: breaks magic stones with heavy finishing blows
personality.inner_conflict: He needs dungeon growth but rejects the magic-sword path that would make him famous instantly.

decision_pattern.battle: Takes the heavy targets, trusts Lili's support, and relies on Bell when surrounded.

quote_samples: 有同伴（队友）真的很好呢。

mannerisms: rests his large blade on his shoulder
habits.daily_routine: Explores with Bell to seek the experience needed for Forge.

preferences.targets: slow large monsters he can hit cleanly

background.upbringing: Taught smithing by his father and grandfather but pressured to restore the family through magic swords.

education.smithing: family instruction and Hephaestus Familia training

formative_events: Nearly died trying solo dungeon progress after being excluded
background.pre_story: Still lacks Forge and therefore needs dangerous dungeon experience.

relationships.bell-cranel: Party leader/customer who saves him from Silverbacks and accepts his secret without demanding magic swords.
relationships.liliruca-arde: Supporter whose coordination he quickly recognizes despite their quarrels.
relationships.hestia: Bell's goddess who investigates his reputation through Hephaestus Familia.

knowledge: Knows he is being used as a temporary member but hopes to prove his worth
Knows Bell's Lv.2 speed and Firebolt are far beyond normal Lv.1 standards
secrets: He can make true Crozzo magic swords but refuses to forge or sell them.
periods.summary: Welf enters Bell's party to earn Forge, fights Orcs effectively with Lili's support, is nearly surrounded by Silverbacks, and learns the relief of having teammates when Bell saves him.

key_events.summary: Welf joins Bell and Lili on the 11th floor to seek experience for Forge.
Bell breaks a Silverback encirclement and Welf realizes the value of teammates.

periods.time: Next day in Welf's personal workshop
periods.label: Welf explains why he refuses magic swords and forges Ushiwakamaru

appearance.overview: In his soot-darkened smith's work clothes, Welf becomes intensely focused before the furnace.
distinctive: work clothes blackened by countless forging jobs

personality.summary: Defines weapons as partners for users, not political tools; rejects magic swords because they corrupt both wielders and smiths and eventually break on their masters.
values: weapons as a user's right hand
fears: his work being valued only as Crozzo magic swords
desires: make Bell a weapon from the Minotaur horn
prove a smith's reason through craft
flaws: stubborn refusal costs him status and wealth
personality.inner_conflict: He can make true magic swords, but doing so would betray his ideal of weapons and repeat Crozzo corruption.

decision_pattern.craft: Faces the material directly, hammers his conviction into the weapon, and refuses shortcuts based on bloodline.

quote_samples: 武器既不是政治工具，也不是飞黄腾达的手段，而是使用者的左右手。
我不打造魔剑。就算打造了，也不卖。

mannerisms: tests whether Bell will ask for a magic sword
names weapons with questionable taste until Bell intervenes
habits.daily_routine: Works alone in his Hephaestus-provided workshop so techniques do not leak to rivals.
quirks: nearly names the dagger '牛短刀' before Bell pleads for '牛若丸'

preferences.weapon_ideal: durable weapons that never abandon their user

background.upbringing: Loved the old workshop and the feel of smithing until his family pushed him to forge magic swords for restoration of status.

education.smithing: family craft plus Hephaestus Familia discipline

formative_events: Ancestor saved a spirit and inherited spirit blood
Crozzo magic swords ruined lands and drew spirit curses
Welf alone can again forge Crozzo magic swords but refuses
background.pre_story: Left home and was taken in by Hephaestus.

relationships.bell-cranel: Entrusts Bell with his reason and gives him Ushiwakamaru from the Minotaur horn.
relationships.hestia: Her investigation of him indirectly forces his secret into Bell's awareness.
relationships.ryu-lion: Her explanation gives Bell historical context on Crozzo magic swords and elves.

knowledge: Knows monster horns can carry metallic Adamant-like properties
Knows Crozzo origin and curse history
Knows Bell did not ask for a magic sword
secrets: Crozzo magic-sword ability comes from inherited spirit blood and remains active in Welf despite the family curse.
periods.summary: Welf takes Bell to his workshop, tests whether Bell wants a magic sword, explains the spirit-blood origin and curse of Crozzo magic swords, rejects magic swords as corrupting weapons that abandon their users, and forges the Minotaur horn into the short blade Ushiwakamaru before asking Bell to address him as a companion.

key_events.summary: Welf explains Crozzo's spirit-blood origin, curse, and his refusal to make magic swords.
Welf forges Bell's Minotaur horn into the short blade Ushiwakamaru.
